about_short_description.short_description: Hala is a digital financial platform for your payments.

product.name: Hala Business IBAN Accounts
product.description: Business accounts for freelancers, SMEs, corporations, and multi-user teams to receive sales, hold funds, make payments, and manage business cash flow.

product.name: Payment Acceptance Solutions
product.description: Payment acceptance through Hala POS terminals and Android-based Soft POS, supporting cards, contactless payments, and digital wallets with settlement to a Hala IBAN account.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A platform for issuing business expense cards, setting spending controls, approving transactions, tracking expenses, managing budgets, and exporting accounting reports.

product.name: Hala Financing
product.description: Sharia-compliant business financing for Saudi SMEs, with funding of up to SAR 2 million for working capital, inventory, equipment, expansion, and payroll needs.

product.name: Hala Restaurant POS (هلا كاشير)
product.description: A cloud-based restaurant point-of-sale system for orders, tables, menus, inventory, recipes, integrated payments, delivery integrations, electronic invoicing, and sales reporting.

product.name: Business Cards
product.description: Mada and Visa debit and purchasing cards for business payments, available in digital and physical formats for local, online, and international transactions.
